notes.title: Defender's Squad - the last ride is now Available for Purchase!!!
notes.notes:
🚀 It's Time! Defender’s Squad: The Last Ride is OUT NOW! 🚀

The galaxy is under attack, and it’s up to you to take the last stand! Jump into this intense SHMUP action, and blast through waves of enemies in this arcade-inspired bullet hell experience!

🔥 Epic Boss Battles
⚡️ Classic Power-Ups
🎮 Full Controller Support & Steam Deck Compatible
🎶 Retro-Inspired Soundtrack
💥 Non-Stop Explosive Action

Thank you to everyone who supported this journey—now, let's save the universe one last time! 🌠

If you encounter any issues or have feedback, please start a topic in the community discussion. I'll be actively monitoring for bug fixes and balance. 
Your input helps make the game even better!

Thanks, and enjoy!!!

notes.title: Steam Deck compatibility
notes.notes:
[h1]Exciting News! 🚀🎮[/h1]

We're officially preparing to request the Steam Deck Verified badge! Our game has already been tested and runs smoothly on the Steam Deck, delivering a fantastic experience.

Fun fact: We actually started developing this game after getting our first Steam Deck—so optimizing it for the device has always been a priority!

If you have a Steam Deck, we’d love for you to check out the game and enjoy the experience. Stay tuned for more updates!



#SteamDeck #Gaming #IndieGame
